reason: A browser-side paperclip control lets users select or drag text and code files into the web composer, where their contents are formatted and inserted for sending to an agent.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 输入框中添加回形针按钮，支持选择或拖拽文本和代码文件并将内容插入消息编辑框。
summaries.en: Adds a paperclip button to the DSH Web GUI composer for selecting or dragging text and code files and inserting their contents into a message.

capabilities: Reads files selected or dragged by the user in the browser
Inserts selected file contents into the chat composer
Supports multiple text and code files within stated size limits
